distribution: Beibeng, Motuo, Tibet, 800 m above sea level; abroad, India.
soldier: Head of the soldier brownish yellow, nasus dark brown, antennae pale brown, mandibles yellowish brown with brownish black tips; thorax and dorsum of the abdomen brown, legs pale brownish yellow. Dorsum of the head with at least three pairs of hairs, thorax with several short hairs, abdomen with both long and short hairs, the tip of the nasus also with short hairs. Posterior part of the head slightly narrow, the anterior margin straight, the middle of the posterior margin slightly arched. Pronotum narrower than the head, saddle-shaped, its anterior margin only slightly concave at the middle, the posterior margin nearly straight. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.
